result.title: Spectral-Aware Proposal Enhancement for Diffusion-Based Multispectral UAV Multi-Object Tracking
result.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters. 5 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Author accepted version
result.summary: Multispectral UAV multi-object tracking (MOT) with oriented bounding boxes remains challenging due to small targets, cluttered backgrounds, and unstable inter-frame associations. Although diffusion-based MOT provides an effective iterative proposal refinement paradigm, existing diffusion-based trackers lack dedicated designs for exploiting multispectral cues in proposal initialization and confidence calibration, limiting tracking robustness in complex UAV scenarios. This letter proposes DSATrack, a diffusion-guided spectral-aware tracking framework for multispectral UAV MOT. Specifically, a lightweight spectral encoder injects multispectral information into the RPN branch through feature fusion, enabling the RPN head to generate high-quality object-aware proposals. These proposals are then injected into the initial proposal set to provide reliable spatial priors for diffusion refinement. Furthermore, a spectral-saliency confidence modulation strategy recalibrates refined tracking confidence according to local multispectral saliency contrast before score thresholding, enhancing spectrally reliable candidates while suppressing unreliable ones. Without modifying the original diffusion refinement head, DSATrack improves both proposal quality and post-refinement candidate selection. Experiments on the MMOT benchmark demonstrate that DSATrack outperforms the adapted DiffusionTrack baseline by 4.6 HOTA, 9.0 MOTA, and 7.7 IDF1 points, showing its effectiveness for multispectral UAV MOT.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DSATrack，在多光谱无人机多目标跟踪的扩散式框架中，用轻量光谱编码器为 RPN 注入多光谱特征以生成高质量候选，并以光谱显著性置信度调制精炼后的候选选择，在 MMOT 基准上相比 DiffusionTrack 基线提升 HOTA、MOTA 与 IDF1。
AI.relevance_reason: 其扩散式迭代精炼循环中「注入可靠空间先验 + 精炼后置信度重标定再阈值筛选」的流程，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态迭代更新、证据筛选与停止/决策机制提供可核查的方法线索，但面向遥感跟踪任务，迁移性需人工判断。
